name: use-media
title: Use Media
description: Follows an audio or video element (playing, time, duration, buffered, volume, rate, text tracks, waiting, error) as React state, with the actions to drive it, the context player parts share, and time formatting through Intl.

meta.when: Building player parts around a `<video>` or `<audio>` element the project renders. video-player, audio-player, captions and scene-strip are built on it; use it directly for a control they do not have. The element stays the source of truth: sources, HLS and DRM are attached to it by the project, and nothing here loads or decodes media.
